payload.statement: Bind retained reasoning to the semantic values and query results it used, including empty queries and selector membership. Reuse it when those dependencies remain current despite unrelated repository changes. Invalidate only affected reasoning when a dependency changes or a new relevant consumer appears. Treat unavailable evidence as unknown. Similarity cannot establish exact or validated reuse.
payload.title: Reuse knowledge with scoped invalidation
